review.item_premise: This body inherits the delivery decision for observation::public_bytes. UTF-8 uses a tagged JSON string; other bytes use padded RFC 4648 base64 and their original length. This body is admitted with default-versus-trace emission: absence of default payload emission does not imply missing instrumentation.
